app.name: Night Heist
app.long_description:
Run a small crew of thieves through four districts of a city at night. Every building is generated: warehouses, offices, banks, mansions and museums, with guards, dogs, cameras, lasers, locks, safes and terminals.
Pick locks and crack safes by twisting the Wii Remote, hack with the pointer, cut the power, throw a coin to pull a guard away, and get out before the police arrive. Between jobs: hire specialists, buy gear, fence collections and keep your heat down.
Needs a Nunchuk. Saves to the SD card.
Controls: pointer looks and aims, stick moves, Z crouch, tilt the Nunchuk to lean, C use, A gadget or takedown, B torch, D-pad gadgets and thermal, + map, - objectives, HOME pause.
